summary: Validated update (valid; effect: interpretation append for the status-guard question, changing rationale only). It records a check I ran on a suspected association gap: the status-guard interpretation carries no experiment binding, and the controller's own association rule confirms that is the correct form here, because the retry receipt it leans on was produced by an experiment owned by the neighbouring recovery-value question - an experiment-bound interpretation would have to identify that owning investigation and cite its own receipt, whereas keeping this question while reusing another's receipt is precisely what the conditional conclusion plus the recorded joint-history reasoning are for. So no field of that account changes; the first attempt's and the retry's receipts stay cited as they are, and the earlier attempt to bind the experiment was correctly rejected by validation. Final state of the run: six questions with explained dispositions, all receipt-backed - the fabricated-self-ballot value adoption up to a completed contradiction of a live replica's committed value; the equal-ballot empty-slice replacement decided by the reply adopted at the slow-quorum trigger position, measured over all six permutations of the three-reply set and four orders of a two-carrier/two-empty set and final because only N - SlowQuorumSize replies can follow; the status-guard stall cleared only by the executor's retry; recovery authority bounded by the recoverer's fixed ballot with no repair on the rejection path; the client-completion contract holding for the single-NOOP case but not for the empty batch; and the wrong-row write in handlePreAccept refuted as unreachable. Eleven receipts, six registered source materials spanning the recovery and executor paths, both facts and all behaviour entries consistent in statements, conditions, dependency pointers and citations, and the captured snapshot untouched.
